title: Accepted-Route Trajectory Directional Sensitivity Composition

qualified_contract.worker_acceptance_boundary: pending direction is promoted only at the existing SoilWater task-3 accepted-step boundary
qualified_contract.outer_transaction_publication_authority: only TX_STATUS_ACCEPTED with exactly one commit may publish an immutable trajectory result
qualified_contract.generic_time_semantics: accepted provenance is bound to exact accepted generic [t0,t1]; non-day-aligned intervals are qualified
qualified_contract.shortened_retry_interval: may publish only its actual accepted [requested_t0,accepted_t1] response and is never relabelled as the full requested window
qualified_contract.unavailable_step_semantics: if an accepted physical step has no qualified smooth-route direction, sensitivity fails closed while the physical solve remains valid
qualified_contract.bottom_exchange_derivative: sum over accepted steps of dt * accepted_step_bottom_flux_derivative

adversarial_owner_review.finding_closed: A discarded retry previously could reissue the same token identity for the same candidate, accepted-step sequence and interval. F-KT21 now advances step_sequence on every issued request rather than only on acceptance, so a stale result from retry A cannot bind to retry B. Regression marker FKT21_RETRY_ABA_TOKEN_REJECTED=PASS is green at O0 and O2.

evidence_invalidation: change to the F-SI37 accepted-step directional derivative contract or qualified source blobs
change to SoilWater task-3 accepted-step publication boundary
change to trajectory token generation, issue sequence or endpoint provenance
change to accepted interval provenance or shortened-interval semantics
change to qualification fixtures or expected fail-closed routes

downstream_state.reason: The existing F-GC23 negative authority requires the upstream F-SI and F-KT capabilities to be separately qualified and admitted before reopening. F-KT21 is owner-qualified here but neither independent verification nor canonical admission is claimed.
downstream_state.next_decision_surface: independent R3 verification and canonical admission of the upstream sensitivity capability chain

hard_nonclaims: no F-GC23 whole-window groundwater response tangent qualification or admission
no derivative through timestep-controller branch changes, fallback changes or nonsmooth physical regime switches
no relabelling of F-SI37 unavailable routes as available
exact_head_requirement: The commit adding this receipt must itself pass the unchanged F-KT21 qualification workflow. That exact green receipt head is the owner capability authority; no final/review/staging branch is required.
